title: ConverseRequest
description: Request body of POST /api/assistant-conversations/:id/converse (HEL-665, reopened composer ticket). The one new user-typed message to send -- the server loads the conversation's existing transcript, calls AssistantService.converse, and (on success) persists the resulting turns, returning the refreshed AssistantConversationResponse (no new response shape).

idempotencyKey.description: HEL-698: optional client-generated retry key. A converse whose key matches the conversation's last-applied key is treated as a no-op replay of an already-landed send (no Claude call, no append). Trimmed; blank treated as absent; longer than 128 characters is rejected with a 400.
